title: The Inner-Product Sign Function
statement: For every natural number $n$, the function on pairs $x,y\\in\\mathbb F_2^n$ given by $(-1)^{\\sum_{j=1}^n x_jy_j}$, with the exponent computed modulo $2$, has absolute value $1$ at every pair.
